author: Carolina Aiazzi (@Cora_Mat)
purpose: Local motion and material comparison reference; not a project-authored asset.
observations: Cursor-led stretches produce smooth lobes and necks, then detached material settles on the floor.
Near 0-3 seconds, different-coloured portions accumulate in an apparently joined smooth patch on the floor.
Near 15-20 seconds, head material stretches sideways into rounded pieces that fall beside the bears.
Pixels alone do not establish whether apparent joining includes mechanical adhesion, visual surface blending, or both.
The exact solver, input button state, internal resolution and measured playback performance are not established by the recording.
